Keep Global Supervision Status
kEXPIRED
⌈
If the
Global Supervision Status
is
kEXPIRED
,

the
GlobalSupervision
corresponds to Operating System, Execution Man-
agement or State Management and the measured Expired Supervision Time is
less than the configured
expiredSupervisionTolerance
OR
•
the
GlobalSupervision
DOES NOT correspond to Operating System, Execu-
tion Management or State Management and the
Elementary Supervision
Status

kEXPIRED
,
then the
Platform Health Management
shall keep the
Global Supervision
Status kEXPIRED
.
⌋
(RS_PHM_00111, RS_PHM_00112)
